purpose: Paperclip pre-upgrade baseline snapshot. Captures the official upstream identity, the historical observed live runtime identity (pre-S02 verdict), the local BOS Light runtime patches that must survive an upstream upgrade, and the fresh-readback requirements that gate any later upgrade. Side-effect-free: read-only, no network calls, no Docker, no git mutation, no secret capture.

trigger_conditions: any new doctrine patch after v1.4.2
any new runtime evidence past the 2026-06-04 failure window
any mutation of runtime-evidence/ files cited below
any new GSD memory entry tagged Paperclip-runtime-stability
any change to vps_targets in M014-S01-runtime-truth-map.json
any change to the stale-id ledger (R3)
any upstream Paperclip release tag past v2026.707.0
any modification of plugin-bos-light/ or adapters/gsdpi-local/
any change to paperclip-runtime.lock.json runtime_target or auth_modes

official_upstream_identity.policy: Verified by independent remote readback (https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip) without touching the live VPS or paperclip.oysana.com runtime.

local_paperclip_checkout.policy: Read-only inventory of Paperclip source code inside this repository. There is NO Paperclip fork or mirror in the local working tree; Paperclip is consumed as an upstream image at runtime, not vendored.

local_references_to_upstream_only.evidence: BOS Light plugin imports / documents the Paperclip plugin spec from upstream master branch.
Plugin SDK referenced as an optional peer dependency (consumed from upstream registry).
Paperclip CLI referenced; CLI is shipped by upstream Paperclip not by this repo.

live_runtime_observed.policy: Live Paperclip runtime identity as observed in the LAST authenticated readback window. Captured here as HISTORICAL OBSERVATION ONLY; not promoted to authoritative. S02 verdict is H-INCONCLUSIVE because T02 was blocked without user confirmation, so all live fields below MUST be re-confirmed via authenticated readback before T02 (upgrade contract) is allowed to fire.
live_runtime_observed.fresh_readback_via: Authenticated GET on https://paperclip.oysana.com/api/health + Postgres SELECT + docker inspect on the VPS, or SSH tunnel probe against 127.0.0.1:3131
live_runtime_observed.current_database_schema_identity_via: Postgres SELECT version() and SELECT extname FROM pg_extension; Paperclip schema introspection on the live DB
live_runtime_observed.current_database_schema_migrations_via: drizzle-kit migration history table; npm --prefix paperclip-sandbox drizzle-kit status
live_runtime_observed.current_volumes_via: docker inspect paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 --format '{{json .Mounts}}' and docker volume ls
live_runtime_observed.current_canonical_company_id_via: Postgres SELECT id, name FROM company WHERE name LIKE '%BOS%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5; OR authenticated GET /api/companies
live_runtime_observed.current_signup_lockdown_check_via: GET https://paperclip.oysana.com/api/auth/sign-up (expect 403 from nginx lockdown per R2); SSH-tunnel probe to 127.0.0.1:3131/api/auth/sign-up (expect 404 from Paperclip) per the in-lockfile forbidden-commands policy

local_runtime_patches_detected.policy: Local source-tree changes that diverge from upstream Paperclip. These patches MUST be reconciled explicitly in T02 before an upgrade — each is either (a) re-applied on the new upstream revision, (b) obsoleted by upstream, or (c) explicitly removed. Detection method is filesystem walk under plugin-bos-light/, adapters/, configs/, scripts/, skills/, company-template/, docs/. No live runtime mutation was performed to detect these patches.

bos_light_plugin.reconciliation_note: All 13 capabilities, 3 UI tabs, and 7 piko tools remain unvalidated against upstream Paperclip per MEM054/MEM058 (plugin registration is fail-closed). T02 upgrade contract must record which capabilities the new upstream revision actually exposes vs which BOS Light requests must be re-validated.

gsdpi_local_adapter.purpose: GSD-Pi local external adapter package — standalone server adapter loaded at startup via Paperclip plugin system per docs/adapters/external-adapters.md.
gsdpi_local_adapter.reconciliation_note: gsdpi_local is unregistered (MEM046); supported Paperclip readback returns 'Unknown adapter type: gsdpi_local'. T02 must not assume registry readback succeeds against the new upstream without re-validation.

reverse_proxy_signup_lockdown.evidence_local: P1 in .gsd/KNOWLEDGE.md + R2 + plugin-bos-light/docs references to nginx `location ^/api/auth/sign-up { allow 127.0.0.1/::1; deny all; }`
reverse_proxy_signup_lockdown.reconciliation_note: Signup lockdown is a nginx-layer policy, NOT a Paperclip-layer policy. It must survive any upstream upgrade because it is not stored inside the Paperclip image. T03 deploy step MUST NOT remove or rewrite the nginx vhost; T04 post-upgrade MUST verify the lockdown is still in place (R2).
reverse_proxy_signup_lockdown.fresh_readback_via: ssh root@87.99.146.178 'nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -A3 "location \^/api/auth/sign-up"' (requires explicit user confirmation per S02 fail-closed gate)

company_template.purpose: BOS Light v1.4.1 company template for /BOS divisions
company_template.reconciliation_note: Company templates are content, not runtime code. T02 contract must record template SHA-256 before upgrade and re-import after upgrade only if upstream schema changed.

scripts_and_configs.purpose: BOS Light doctrine, handoffs, and probe scripts. Not part of Paperclip runtime.
scripts_and_configs.reconciliation_note: Scripts are local-only and run against Paperclip HTTP API; they are not affected by a Paperclip upstream revision bump. However, scripts/validate_m014_s03_script_hardening.js MUST be re-run after upgrade because R3 stale-id membership may shift if Paperclip rotates company IDs.

plugin_sdk_version_floor.reconciliation_note: T02 upgrade contract must record the SDK floor the new upstream revision requires and whether plugin-bos-light still satisfies it. If the new upstream drops or renames a capability used by plugin-bos-light (e.g. 'actions.register'), the upgrade MUST be marked incompatible and T03 must NOT deploy until the plugin source is patched and re-tested.

rollout_safety_constraints.policy: Constraints inherited from paperclip-runtime.lock.json and the M014 S02 forensic verdict. These MUST remain in force through T02-T04; the upgrade contract MUST reference every one of them by name.

inherited_constraints.rule: verified_base_url and canonical_company_id MUST be null until a fresh authenticated readback promotes them; mutation scripts refuse to run with null values unless PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID_OVERRIDE=allow is set
Public sign-up (POST /api/auth/sign-up) MUST NOT be invoked against the public host for recon; nginx lockdown is the source of truth and MUST remain in place
PAPERCLIP_API_KEY is REJECTED as an auth source; session-cookie is the only allowed mode
VPS forensic verdict was H-INCONCLUSIVE with zero captures; explicit user confirmation is required before any future VPS read-only probe
Zero-capture state means no failure hypothesis (H-WIPE, H-RECREATE, H-AUTH-DRIFT, H-OWNERSHIP-DRIFT, H-PROXY-DRIFT) can be promoted; all six R3 stale IDs remain unverified as live
T01 baseline cannot assert wipe/recreate/auth-drift/ownership-drift/proxy-drift; it can only assert upstream-identity, local-patches-detected, and fresh-readback-required

S04_T02_upgrade_contract.must_pin_revision_to: official_upstream_identity.upstream_commit_sha_for_latest_release (or a chosen known-good SHA inside the same release line)

anti_replay.policy: Each baseline capture is one-shot. Reusing a baseline for a different upgrade cycle requires a fresh T01 capture with a new generated timestamp and a new fresh_readback_required=true assertion.
